name: What should I decide before ordering a replacement bathroom countertop?

mainEntity.name: What should I decide before ordering a replacement bathroom countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before ordering a new bathroom countertop, verify your sink style, faucet spread, and mirror clearance. Decide whether you want an undermount, drop-in, or vessel sink, as each requires specific cutout dimensions and plumbing rough-in heights. You should also check the faucet hole configuration, such as single-hole or widespread, so the fabricator can drill the stone accurately. Finally, measure the distance between the countertop surface and your existing wall-mounted mirrors or medicine cabinets to ensure adequate clearance for an integrated backsplash.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide on your sink style, faucet hole spread, and countertop thickness, and confirm clearance under existing mirrors and wall fixtures before fabrication begins.
